description: PL.core-dock-operations-register. POST /api/v1/worlds/{worldId}/reference-texts/reread: re-read a finished world's reference texts (Create World, Unreal). 202 with a taskId polled through getGenerationProgress. requestCases: what a dock asks for (input: worldId, query parameters by name, a parsed JSON body) -> the request it must send (method, the expanded path, query, body: the JSON value to send or null for none), or the refusal (code, received) with no request at all. An absent body, null and {} all mean no body. row: the published openapi/operations.json row this file is about (method, path, pathParameters, queryParameters, auth, verdict) plus what a request may carry (body, bodyMembers) and whether contentWriteFindings admits it, with the reason; a test holds row to the stamped table and to the vendored contract. cases: no response cases yet (the docks' readers of these answers are the engines' own; none is in core). Reference: src/editor/dock-operations.ts dockOperationRequest, run by src/editor/__tests__/dock-operations.test.ts.

contentWrite.why: Admitted by decision (PL.core-dock-operations-register): a POST not named as a write and on no entity collection, and not a content write in the guard's sense. It is a generation kick-off like startWorldGeneration: the contract declares no request body, so the dock sends no content; the server re-runs the pipelines job reread-texts on the world as it stands, and what lands is the generator's reading of the world's own reference texts. A body with anything in it is refused (unexpected-body), which is the condition of the admission.
